dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Could you tell from my voice, or did someone tell you? If it's the former, then I gotta say, you've got a sharp pair of ears.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: That's right, I'm from Snezhnaya. But right now, I'm just a shopkeeper carving out a living in Nasha Town. Nothing more, nothing less.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Compared to my icy hometown, I'm more used to the climate here... and the people. Their thoughts aren't quite as tangled up, and even their lies are, all in all, rather... simple.
